supporting_observations.claim: At 13:45:31 UTC, FILE-SUN-01 sent 640,000,366 bytes to the internal proxy at 10.55.20.30:8080; the connection record reports 39,199 response bytes. This is consistent with the alerted large transfer, but the record identifies the proxy—not the ultimate destination.
A smaller connection from FILE-SUN-01 to the same proxy occurred about one second earlier, but it does not establish the destination or purpose of the large transfer.

The transfer's size is consistent with the inventory description of approved Arcvault offsite backups, which upload several hundred MB, but available records do not attribute this connection to the Arcvault agent.

known_telemetry_limitations: FILE-SUN-01 winsec and Sysmon collection was unavailable from 13:30 to 14:20 UTC, so process, user, and endpoint activity for the transfer are not present in those sensors.
PROXY-SUN-01 proxy-log collection was unavailable from 13:30 to 14:20 UTC, leaving the large connection's external destination and proxy-level details unobserved.
Zeek connection telemetry is available, but the cited record shows the internal proxy as the destination and does not identify the ultimate external endpoint.
claims_not_established: Whether the transfer went to the approved Arcvault service or to another destination.
Which process, account, job, or user initiated the large transfer.
What data was transferred or whether it was authorized.
Whether the large transfer was malicious or a legitimate backup.
additional_evidence_needed: Recover or obtain proxy logs for the transfer time, including the external destination, request details, and any available transaction or byte counts.
Obtain FILE-SUN-01 endpoint telemetry or backup-agent logs showing the initiating process, account, files, and upload outcome.
Verify the corresponding Arcvault backup job and upload against its expected schedule and destination.
unrelated_findings: A domain controller record shows a service ticket request for svc-store with a client IP of 45.79.19.196. Investigate separately; the available record does not link it to the alerted proxy transfer. (T240-00221)

A PowerShell explicit-credential event on WS-ZADAMS-01 used svc-ledger to access FILE-SUN-01 before the scheduled 13:30 password rotation. Investigate separately; it does not establish who initiated or what caused the alerted transfer. (T240-00029)
